criteria_evidence.name: Human Subjects Only
criteria_evidence.explanation: Abstract indicates in vivo study conducted exclusively on Sprague-Dawley rats with no human clinical trial cohort.
criteria_evidence.evidence_snippet: Male Sprague-Dawley rats were treated with metformin (200 mg/kg) daily for 8 weeks.

criteria_evidence.name: Comparative Clinical Design
criteria_evidence.explanation: Active and vehicle control arms identified.
criteria_evidence.evidence_snippet: Animals were randomized to vehicle or metformin treatment groups.
